sample.text: Hey, so, I was just thinking about this: Sometimes you start your day with absolutely no idea how it’s going to go. You grab a coffee, check your phone, and suddenly, wait, what? It’s already ten o’clock. Anyway, it’s fine. Take a breath, slow down.  We’ve got plenty of time! Actually, you know what? I think today’s going to be a good day.
